meta.name: og-dbr-rev0
meta.notes: Orange Gate DBR Rev 0 baseline. All figures from DBR MSTX-OG-DBR-001 Rev 0 (K 4.1 @ 50 bar → 29.0 lpm/head; 25 heads/zone × 3 = 75 active, 2175 lpm flow). Explicitly stated DBR figures: tunnel bore/deck/gradient/length, nozzle K/pressure/height, nozzle SMD 100 µm (fine mode). By field name, nozzles.modes[].cone_half_angle_deg and nozzles.modes[].launch_velocity_ms are carried illustration defaults (45.0 deg, 15.0 m/s) restated here only because the schema requires a complete mode block once smd_um is set explicitly -- they are NOT measured figures and still need real values, alongside hydraulics.static_head_bar and hydraulics.fittings_loss_bar, which remain inherited from the illustration preset (not stated in this file) and likewise still need real measured data before assessment. Golden-deck baseline for optimisation loop.

constraints.note: Site and procurement limits. NOT from SOLIT2 and not acceptance criteria.

ahj.note: Only one acceptance limit is set, because only one is stated by an authority. HPWM-TECHNICAL SPEC_R2 section 6 requires a 150 MW minimum design fire load reduced to <= 50 MW. Every other Annex 7 criterion stays null and is reported 'unset': the tender defers tenability to 'SOLIT2 or NFPA 502 test protocols' without naming numbers, and Annex 7 7.1 leaves those to the authority having jurisdiction. Do not fill them from a vendor's test report -- see INDEPENDENCE.md rule 2.
